text: Finally, [VAR 0100(0000)]!\nI’ve been waiting forever for you![VAR 0114(0005)]

I’d thought Glimwood Tangle was a real maze,
but this place is on an entirely different level...\c
And it’s so hot and humid that I’m sweating a
pond over here![VAR 0114(0005)]

Sonia and I split up places to survey. And she
opted for the cold and snow—and all.\c
Too bad we can’t somehow divide this heat up
between us, too. We’d both feel a bit better![VAR 0114(0005)]

Anyway, I was checking out this Forest of Focus
place while I was waiting for you to show up...\c
and I saw signs that [VAR FF00(0006)]Lilligant[VAR FF00(0000)] and [VAR FF00(0006)]Applin
[VAR FF00(0000)]live here![VAR 0114(0005)]
Maybe we can gather a bit of sweet nectar that\nUrshifu should love from their flowers and fruit.[VAR 0114(0005)]

I reckon [VAR FF00(0006)]Lilligant[VAR FF00(0000)] and [VAR FF00(0006)]Applin[VAR FF00(0000)] are the most likely
Pokémon to produce any nectar here in the
Forest of Focus.\c
Let’s see if they can’t spare a bit for Urshifu![VAR 0114(0005)]
